title: Protocol and Cipher
author: August Whitlock
blurb: Emrys Brightwater, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
